trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order: finish the story, clear the stranger mission strands, then work through collectibles and activities, and save the 100% completion trophy for last. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, which introduces Lucia and Jason and teaches the basic movement, driving and fishing controls. It cannot be missed: just play through the story from the start and it pops when the mission ends. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. While you play Chapter 1, do the Lucia balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude, because that one spot disappears once the chapter ends. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Complete all of Chapter 2's missions in story order and the trophy unlocks at the chapter finale. Chapter 2 opens up more of Leonida, so use the downtime between missions to start discovering vehicles for Whip It Good. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play through every Chapter 3 mission to its finale and the trophy pops. By this point the map is wide open, so it is a good moment to chip away at area exploration for The Goodtime State between story beats. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish the last story chapter's missions and the trophy unlocks at the end of Chapter 4. Before you start the final mission, make a manual save: there is no mission replay and no New Game Plus, so that save is your safety net for anything story-related you still need. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the game's final mission after Chapter 4 and this gold trophy pops. Make a manual save right before the finale, because once it is done there is no way to replay the mission, and the save lets you return to free roam for cleanup. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission flow. Story missions unlock in order, so keep playing the main path and it will come up on its own. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist, one of the game's big heist set pieces. It unlocks through the story, so follow the mission markers and finish it to earn the trophy. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears in the mission list. Like the other named story missions, it comes up in the natural story order and cannot be missed by playing through. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Keep following the story missions in order and it will unlock when its turn comes. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. It is part of the main story path, so play the missions in order until it appears and finish it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It unlocks in the story order, so just keep playing the main missions until it shows up and see it through. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game's stats screen, which means finishing the story, all stranger mission strands, the collectible sets and the activity checklists. It is the last trophy most players earn, right before the platinum, so use the in-game completion percentage to find what is left. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts: jumps, near misses, drifts and other driving feats the game counts as you drive. The counter builds up naturally across a full playthrough, and a fast car on the highways plus the stunt jump ramps scattered around Leonida speed it up. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once: fishing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone races, meditation, bowling, races, hunting and the other open-world pastimes. You do not need to master any of them, just sample each one, and the trophy pops when the last type is tried. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the game's ranges. Learn each range's scoring, use the right weapon for the drill, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold is met; the counter tracks each gold separately. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own course, so learn the gates and shortcuts per track, and keep the drone low and steady through the turns rather than racing flat out. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races: each race counts only once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins on the same track. Work through the race list across Leonida with a well-upgraded car and take the racing line through corners. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge: meet him at a fishing spot, take the challenge, and land the bigger catch. Watch the line tension, reel in when the fish runs toward you, and ease off when it pulls hard so the line does not snap. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish at an arcade machine around Leonida. Pick a machine, learn its controls in one quick run, then play a full game through to its end screen. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Andy's stranger mission strand. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida and meet their characters, so follow Andy's missions through to the last one. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Kenton's stranger mission strand. Work through Kenton's missions in order as they appear on the map and finish the strand's finale. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Billy's stranger mission strand. Find Billy's missions around Leonida, play them in order, and the trophy pops when the strand's last mission ends. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete all 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida, including the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone. Strangers appear as map icons as you explore, so visit every region and clear each strand to its final mission. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Randy's stranger mission strand. Play Randy's missions in order as they unlock and finish the strand's finale. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's stranger mission strand. Follow Tyrone's missions through the strand to its final mission and finish it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations in Leonida. MISSABLE: the Lucia balcony spot in Chapter 1 is only available during that chapter, so do it before Chapter 1 ends. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTABase.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret: take his hunting request, track the animal in the wilds of Leonida, and bring it down. Move slowly, use cover and the wind, and take the shot only when the animal is still. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets by finding the cards hidden around Leonida. Cards are tucked into shops, interiors and landmarks, so sweep each region methodically and check the collection screen to see which sets are still missing cards. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. The counter only counts each location once, so keep moving to new spots rather than repeating the same one, and cover every region of the map. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list, which spans driving, combat, exploration and activities. The list is broad, so pick the easiest ones first and let the counter grow as you play; the trophy pops at 50. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build up a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Use the partner's help to break line of sight, duck into alleys or off-road, and stay out of the search cones until the wanted level clears. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops, keep the robberies quick, and stay ahead of the police response while you move from one to the next. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by driving, spotting and entering them around Leonida. The counter grows as you encounter new models, so drive through every district, check parking lots and traffic, and hop into anything you have not logged yet. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Pick a fight with a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before the focus meter runs out. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: get to the airfield, take a plane, and leave without a flight plan. The airport is restricted, so move fast, dodge security, and get airborne before the wanted level catches up. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and cause chaos with it. Find a Rhino at a military site or during a story beat, climb in, and the trophy pops once you are rolling in it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected: go in quiet, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, and get out before the alarm trips. Plan the entry, move fast once inside, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vault robberies need planning: pick your entry, crack the vault, grab the take and break the wanted level before you are caught. Each successful escape counts toward the five. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape: find one on the roads of Leonida, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the wanted level. A sticky approach on a quiet road works better than a chase through traffic. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida, from Vice City to the swamps and the Keys. The map fills in as you travel, so drive, fly and boat through every region and check the map for blank patches until all 52 areas are logged. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations, so find one per gang, hit it, and escape; the counter tracks which gangs you have already robbed. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. It is a quiet moment trophy: sit down, take in the sunset over the water, and the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom: drive a car straight through the showroom glass in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom, build up speed outside, and crash through the front window to trigger it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on a full game. Rent a lane, bowl your frames, and finish the game to earn the trophy. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build your partnership's appeal with the public until it reaches mass appeal. Do activities together, keep your partner happy, and the partnership's reputation will grow until the trophy pops. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make a story choice: at a decision point in the game, pick one of the offered paths. The trophy pops when the choice is made, whichever way you go, so there is no wrong answer for this one. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on your second attempt at something the game lets you retry: fail once, then try again and pull it off. The trophy is about the retry, so a failed first attempt is part of the path to it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Trigger one of the game's strangest random encounters: something odd happens out in Leonida and the trophy pops when you witness it. Keep exploring the odd corners of the map and it will find you. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by: drive past a group on foot and swing a melee weapon from the vehicle to knock them down. A slow pass through a crowded sidewalk with a bat makes this easy to set up. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from heists and robberies, and your contacts clean them for a cut; keep feeding bills through until the $250,000 total is reached. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida: clothes, weapons, cars, food and everything else counts toward the total. It builds up naturally over a full playthrough, and big purchases like vehicles speed it along. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PlayStationTrophies.org GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Each garage costs money and gives you storage, so save up, visit each property marker, and buy them one by one until all 8 are yours. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app: find vehicles around Leonida, open the app, and register each one. Any 10 distinct vehicles count, so register the ones you discover while working on Whip It Good. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.name: On the Spot
